name: Early Training Evaluation of Language Models
description: This task focuses on designing evaluation benchmarks tailored to measure the early training progress of small language models (SLMs) in acquiring scientific knowledge. Participants are invited to develop novel evaluation methodologies or adapt existing benchmarks to better capture performance differences among SLMs during early training stages.

cr:input.name: SLM Checkpoints
cr:input.description: Intermediate checkpoints of small language models (0.5B, 1B, and 3B parameters) trained on up to 200 billion tokens. Models are trained on two data mixtures: Web-only Dataset (FineWeb subset) and Scientific Knowledge Data Mixture (comprising FineWeb-edu, The Stack V1/V2, InfiMM, and TxT360).
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predictions from the evaluation benchmarks designed to assess scientific knowledge acquisition in SLMs. These predictions include model scores on tasks such as MMLU-var, GPQA, and MATH, with values reflecting the model's reasoning and knowledge capabilities.

field.name: task_name
field.description: The name of the benchmark task (e.g., MMLU-var, GPQA, MATH).

field.name: model_score
field.description: The score achieved by the model on the benchmark task. Example values: 0.26, 0.32.

field.name: training_tokens
field.description: The number of tokens the model was trained on at the time of evaluation. Example values: 50 billion, 200 billion.
